description: List a domain's mail servers (MX records) and which provider handles its email (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 and others). Use to find who hosts a domain's email or why it cannot receive mail. Returns pass, warn or fail, the record as published, what was found, how to fix it, and a guide link. The value lists the mail servers, highest priority first.

domain.description: The domain to check, e.g. example.com. A URL or email address also works.

name: check_mx

records.description: One row for the record checked: pass/warn/fail, the record as published, what was found, the fix and a guide link.

finding.description: What was found, in one sentence.

fix.description: What to change. Empty when nothing needs doing.

guide.description: Pipefire guide that explains this record.

record.description: Which record: MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI or MTA-STS.

value.description: The record as published, or null if there is none.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a free web tool on pipefire.ai.

title: MX lookup
